summary: Deliver lifecycle gates via SessionStart additionalContext and delete ensure-claude-md-gates.sh — the plugin never mutates user files
context: Issue #9: the plugin appended a gates block to the project's CLAUDE.md on every session start.
rationale: additionalContext puts the same guidance in the model's context with zero file writes and works on resume; the CLAUDE.md mutation was the root cause of #9 and produced surprise diffs.
